justification: HOLY COW, folks, lineup card's mostly writin' itself this week! Jordy Love's stayin' right there under center -- I was singin' his praises in print last week and a man don't go backin' off a fella he just tipped his cap to, Aaron Rodgers can keep holdin' that clipboard a while longer. Bijan's rollin' and Isaiah Likely and Stefon Diggs already got their Thursday tickets punched, so those fellas are locked in and lovin' it. Only real move today: D'Andre Swift's got the week OFF up in Chicago, zero on the board for a fella who ain't even playin', so I'm turnin' the card over and slottin' in Aaron Jones Sr. up in Minnesota -- he's got a real ballgame to play, and that's just good sense, not a storyline. Hockenson's wearin' a Questionable tag but a little injury report never scared off Harry Caray, folks, a little rain never hurt anybody, he's starting and I like our chances. Bring on Maura and the Rams D, we're ready for a BALLGAME!
